svg.title: The Dapr API posting an order topic from the cart service to the shipping and email services
svg.desc: Three dashed bands side by side. The left, captioned Publish, holds a green hexagon named Cart joined to a hexagon carrying the Dapr logo. The middle, captioned Pub/sub components, lists Redis, NATS, Azure Service Bus and RabbitMQ. The right, captioned Subscribe, holds two rows, each a Dapr sidecar joined to a service hexagon, named Shipping and Email. Under the cart sidecar is the call it makes: POST over the path /v1.0/publish/pubsub/order, carrying the order data. Under each subscriber sidecar is the call that reaches it: POST over the path /order, carrying the same data.
